edges: Mr. Krabs is the son of Mama Krabs.
Mama Krabs is appalled by SpongeBob and Patrick's use of bad words.
Mama Krabs punishes Mr. Krabs, SpongeBob, and Patrick by making them paint her house.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: SpongeBob SquarePants is the main character in the episode Sailor Mouth.
The episode Sailor Mouth faced criticism from the Parents Television Council.
SpongeBob and Patrick use the bad word in their conversations.
The episode Sailor Mouth received positive reviews.
